en.title: Difference Between Uppercase and Lowercase Letter Counts
en.description:
Compute the number of uppercase English letters in the text minus the number of lowercase English letters. Digits, spaces, and punctuation are ignored. The result for an empty string is 0.

The input format, examples, and test data were compiled and written by CSWork.
en.input: One line of 0..100 printable ASCII characters (spaces allowed); the whole line is kept, and leading and trailing spaces are not trimmed.
en.output: Output the answer as described; separate multiple results with spaces in order, and output an empty line for an empty array.
en.explanation: Example 1: CodeSignal has 2 uppercase letters, C and S, and 8 lowercase letters, so the output is 2−8=−6.
hints: Scan the characters: add one for uppercase, subtract one for lowercase, and leave the running total unchanged for any other character.
